props.name: Glass-fronted reception desk
props.prompt: A broad, angular desk behind a waist-high clear glass shield, with a narrow pass-through and a severe black counter; neatly aligned blank forms sit within reach.

props.name: Chrome queue posts
props.prompt: Short polished-steel stanchions connected by taut burgundy belts, arranged in crisp switchbacks that make a five-person queue feel disciplinary.

props.name: Lobby marble planter
props.prompt: A square white-marble trough holding a clipped, glossy-leaved plant trimmed into a bland corporate globe; the leaves have a faint coat of dust.

props.name: Bolted lobby bench
props.prompt: A rigid three-seat bench of perforated charcoal metal on a shared steel base, polished smooth at the edges by people waiting without being invited to sit.

props.name: IT Security checkpoint kiosk
props.prompt: A waist-high gray inspection podium with a black glass top, a red indicator lens, and a shallow tray for employee badges; its blank screen reflects no faces clearly.

props.name: Elevator call pedestal
props.prompt: A narrow steel pedestal beside the elevator doors, with a grid of unlabeled, differently worn buttons; a few buttons have tiny tactile notches, and the lowest row is immaculate.

props.name: Uncleaned breakroom fridge
props.prompt: A dented white refrigerator with a rusting handle and a gasket stained near-black; a viscous dark seep gathers below the door, reflecting a faint oily sheen.

props.name: Lobby water cooler
props.prompt: A cloudy plastic water jug perched on a scratched white dispenser; small blank sticky notes cling to its side, folded inward so no writing can be read.

props.name: Overloaded paper cart
props.prompt: A squeaky gray metal trolley stacked with uneven reams and loose sheets, several corners bent as if repeatedly handled and then abandoned.

props.name: Confidential shredding bin
props.prompt: A locked waist-high bin with a narrow slot; pale paper strips bulge from the lid seam and collect in a tidy little drift at its base.

props.name: Foldaway holding cot
props.prompt: A narrow folding cot with a thin white vinyl mattress and a neatly tucked gray blanket, set up with the impersonal readiness of a room used too often.

props.name: Lucky Kettle tea cart
props.prompt: A compact cream enamel cart with a copper kettle, a few chipped cups, and a small green tea tin; its wheels are mismatched but carefully oiled.

props.name: Synergy stock rack
props.prompt: A narrow industrial rack loaded with squared stacks of blank paper, toner boxes, and sealed cartons; every package faces outward with its labels turned away.

props.name: Thorne's glass display case
props.prompt: A waist-high glass case on a dark wooden base, holding a few carefully spaced brass curios and one empty velvet pad, as if the missing item is still being priced.

props.name: Thorne's training station
props.prompt: A squat charcoal practice podium beside a pair of thick, scuffed floor mats; red tape marks neat lanes that stop short of a blank beige target board.

props.name: Vane's model-home console
props.prompt: A polished walnut console table with a single cream ceramic bowl and a brass desk clock stopped at an ordinary working hour; its showroom-perfect surface has no personal objects.

props.name: Nap Pod rest capsule
props.prompt: A sealed-looking pale-gray recline capsule with a blue padded interior, a narrow oval opening, and a small pool of soft blue light beneath its base.

props.name: Gray Suit uniform locker
props.prompt: A tall gunmetal locker with open cubbies holding identical pressed gray jackets on hangers; the empty lower compartments are clean enough to look recently inspected.

props.name: Recessed floor uplight
props.prompt: A flush black floor canister casting a narrow cold-white beam upward, bright enough to reveal dust in the air but not warm enough to comfort anyone.

surfaces.name: Polished Corporate Marble
surfaces.prompt: Broad ivory marble tiles with thin gray veins and a mirror gloss; black stone strips mark immaculate routes that seem designed to discourage lingering.

surfaces.name: Beige Static Carpet
surfaces.prompt: Low beige office carpet, faintly mottled with darker squares where furniture has stood for years; the pile looks permanently flattened.

surfaces.name: Elevator Call Zone
surfaces.prompt: A rectangular field of pale gray stone inset with narrow brushed-steel lines converging on the elevator doors, like a queue diagram without instructions.

blueprint.summary: A marble lobby funnels arrivals past a glass-fronted reception fortress into a central waiting hub and guarded elevator bank. Seven small, conspicuously branded frontages ring the public space; a concealed records room behind reception keeps the lobby’s unwanted departures out of sight.

areas.name: Reception Fortress
areas.purpose: The formal arrival point, laid out so every visitor is visible to reception and security. Its glass shield is immaculate; a narrow service gap behind the desk leads to the concealed records room.

areas.name: Unlisted Holding Room
areas.purpose: A concealed room behind reception keeps catatonic former employees from public view. Orderly cots and a shredding bin make it look like temporary records processing.

areas.name: Elevator Security Checkpoint
areas.purpose: The guarded route upward, and the only link to the Open Floor. Officers inspect badges and question unauthorized emotional engagement; elevator controls offer no plain instructions.

areas.name: Public Waiting Hub
areas.purpose: The lobby’s central gathering space: employees wait, trade glances, and pretend not to read notes by the cooler. Clear marble lanes stay passable even when benches fill.

areas.name: The Lucky Kettle frontage
areas.purpose: A small tea counter frontage facing the public hub. The cart and a few waiting cups promise a modest pause, though the polished marble around it leaves no obvious place to settle in.

areas.name: The Synergy Supply Store frontage
areas.purpose: A compact supply-store frontage with stock stacked in disciplined ranks, ready for departments to replenish their paper assets and their explanations for losing them.

areas.name: Thorne's Shop frontage
areas.purpose: A restrained display frontage that makes ordinary objects look as though they require approval to touch. The empty velvet pad is placed where it can be seen from the main corridor.

areas.name: Thorne's Training Hall frontage
areas.purpose: A practical forecourt for training appointments, marked into tidy lanes from the public entrance. Scuffed mats suggest the lessons are less theoretical than the signage implies.

areas.name: Vane's House frontage
areas.purpose: An unnervingly domestic frontage presented as a model of a life beyond work. Its spotless console offers no evidence that anyone has ever lived there.

areas.name: The Nap Pod Lounge frontage
areas.purpose: A compact rest-lounge frontage with its capsule facing away from the busiest traffic, a small concession to privacy in a building that does not believe in it.

areas.name: The Gray Suit Armory frontage
areas.purpose: A severe IT Security frontage, uniforms identical and no personal belongings in sight. The open floor before it makes the doorway feel like a checkpoint, even without an officer.

areas.name: Breakroom Fridge Nook
areas.purpose: A conspicuously neglected breakroom corner by the public route. The refrigerator has gone uncleaned since 2009; dark seep draws curious visitors close enough to hear its whispered offers.
